newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Deadline to submit candidacies for November 3 presidential and parlamentary polls was set for October 3, midnight, the radio said.
* Romania's Senate and lower Chamber of Deputies to meet in special session to discuss government decisions on November 3 elections.
* The Chamber of Deputies has ratified the Romanian-Hungary treaty, endorsed by the Senate last week.
* General George Joulwan, Supreme Allied Commander of all NATO Forces in Europe said signing of Romanian-Hungary treaty is a major step for both countries' plans to join NATO.
* Presidential spokesman Traian Chebeleu hailed initiative by U.S Congress regarding Romania's integration into NATO. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
